units.text: A demanding task or a rival with standing tests your work this year, and you hold up under it better than anyone expects.
Your work gains a title, a rule book or a formal promise this year, and you carry more trust at the end of it than at the start.
Your work turns toward study and specialist skill this year, and you learn more out of sight than you earn in plain view.
A colleague or partner reaches for the same credit this year, and you keep your share by naming it before anyone else does.
Your work loosens and pleases people this year, and you get paid more readily for what you enjoy making.
Pressure settles into your body this year as tension you carry without noticing, and you feel it first in your sleep.
You grow fastest this year where something forces you to, a deadline or a rival or a role with real stakes.
